keyword: buy one get one free chipotle
claims: Chipotle is offering a Buy One, Get One (BOGO) free entrée deal on Friday, March 13, 2026, from 3 p.m. to 4 p.m. local time.
Customers must show a tattoo (permanent, temporary, or drawn-on) in-store to receive one free entrée with the purchase of an entrée of equal or greater value.
The promotion is available in-restaurant only at participating U.S. and Canada locations.
Customers redeem by showing ink (real or drawn-on) at the register.
The promotion includes burritos, bowls, salads, and tacos.

The free item requires the purchase of a full-priced entrée of equal or greater value
